acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A reader who opens README.md on main sees one new line not there before, proven by viewing the file on GitHub after merge.
acceptanceCriteria.skill: none: reviewed legion-worker and dispatch skills; no repository engineering skill governs a plain-text README append.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: GitHub-rendered README.md on the main branch of sjawhar/legion-smoke (the user-facing file view).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The PR passes the repository's required checks, proven by green check status on the PR.
acceptanceCriteria.skill: none: CI is a single GitHub Actions job; no repository skill drives it.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: GitHub Actions 'ci' workflow, job 'check' (.github/workflows/ci.yml), reported as the PR's required status check.

evidence.implement: PR opened on sjawhar/legion-smoke; README.md diff shows exactly one added line, no other file changed; ci/check green at head SHA; E2E proof line recorded in implement handoff.
evidence.review: Verify single-file diff, green required check, and threads on GitHub; run thermonuclear review pair at final head.
evidence.test: Independently re-run the acceptance-1 file view and acceptance-2 ci/check status; record implementerProof verdict and own E2E line.

fileLevelWork: README.md: append exactly one new line of plain text at end-of-file (e.g. a Stage 3 proof marker line naming issue S392083388-1). No other file may change; the change touches exactly one file per the spec requirement.
If a review round requests it: append one additional plain-text line to the same README.md within the same PR — this is in scope per spec.
ordering: 1. Verify README.md exists at HEAD (jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" file list -r @ README.md). If missing, stop and report per spec Errors table — do not create a substitute file.
2. Append exactly one line to README.md end-of-file; confirm no other tracked file changed (jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --summary shows only README.md).
3. Commit, set bookmark legion/S392083388-1, push, open PR with body line 'Dispatch: S392083388-1'.
4. Prove acceptance-1 surface (README diff / GitHub file view) and acceptance-2 surface (ci/check green) before completing implement phase.
6. Reviewer verifies CI/threads/E2E on GitHub; a review may request one more appended line (in scope).
7. On clean review, delete .legion/, merge (human), implementer verifies the line on main post-merge.

implement: none: reviewed the session skill list (legion-worker, legion-retro, dispatch, envoy) and repository state; no repository engineering skill governs appending a plain-text line to README.md — the legion-worker skill's push/PR procedure is followed as standing worker process, not a domain skill.
review: none: no repository review skill applies; review follows legion-worker's PR/thread/thermonuclear discipline against a single-file README diff.
test: none: no repository test/smoke/e2e skill exists for this sandbox; verification is a direct GitHub file view plus the single ci/check status, both covered by legion-worker's proof discipline.

risks: The change must touch exactly one file — adding any second file (including stray smoke/*.txt) fails the spec requirement.
Do not create a substitute file if README.md is missing; stop and report.
summary: Append exactly one new line of plain text to the end of README.md in sjawhar/legion-smoke on this issue's smoke branch, open a PR, and let CI's required check pass. If review requests it, append one additional line to the same README.md within the same PR.
